name: FilterBar
summary: The row above a list: a search box, quick filter chips, more filters in a menu, the active filter count, clear all, and an end slot for view toggles. One value array holds every filter that is on.
useWhen: A list, grid or table the person narrows with a search and a few filters
Quick filters that are on or off, with rarer ones tucked in a menu
A gallery or file browser with view toggles at the end of the filter row
avoidWhen: Picking one view from a few, such as All, Mine, Shared
Filters that each need a range, a date or a typed value
A search that opens a list of suggestions to pick from

search.description: Props for the search box, aria-label included. Leave it out for no search.

filters.description: Quick filters as chips: value, label, textValue, disabled.

more.description: Rarer filters, as checkbox items in the more menu. The menu stays open while the person picks.

value.description: Controlled: the values of every filter that is on, from the chips and the menu.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new list of values.

onClear.description: Called by clear all, after the value and the search box are cleared.

resultCount.description: The results the filters leave. Shown in the count part, and announced once when it changes after a filter or search change.

end.description: View toggles or a sort menu, at the end of the row.

size.description: Height of the search box, the chips and the buttons.

labels.description: Copy for the group name, more, clear and the counts. Default from the Theme language, English or Arabic.

a11y.role: none on the root. The chips sit in a role group named Filters; each chip is a toggle button with aria-pressed.
a11y.focus: Each part is a tab stop in DOM order: search, each chip, more, clear, then the end slot. When clear all is used it hides, and focus moves to the search box, else the first chip.

keys.Tab: Moves to the next part, and to each chip in turn
keys.Space: Turns the focused chip on or off

a11y.announce: The result count is read once, politely, when resultCount changes after a filter or search change, 600ms after the last such change: typing does not read every count, and a slow count is not read stale. A change that leaves the count the same is not announced. Each chip says pressed or not pressed.
notes: The order names ToggleGroup, MultiSelect and Select. They do not exist yet, so filters are Chips in a role group and more is a DropdownMenu with checkbox items. Arrow keys do not move between chips: each chip is a tab stop, as in the Figma-Killer-2 source. The anatomy stays when ToggleGroup lands.

The chip strip scrolls sideways inside itself and never scrolls the page at 320px (WCAG 1.4.10). The root carries data-overflow-start and data-overflow-end in logical terms, so the edge fades flip in RTL.
A selected chip shows a check, not color alone.
data-selected is on each selected Chip root inside the filters part.
open and closed are on the more part, the Button that opens the DropdownMenu. Escape in the search box clears the query; Escape in the more menu closes it and returns focus to the more button.
A search query counts as one filter on in the count part, and clear all empties it too.

The more part is the Button that opens the DropdownMenu. open, closed and data-selected in states sit on nested roots (the more Button and the selected Chips); the FilterBar root carries data-active and the overflow states.

en.filters: One to three words in sentence case, a noun: Images, Shared with me. Never a verb.
en.more: More filters, with the number on in brackets: More filters (2).
en.count: 1 filter on, 2 filters on (a search query counts as one), then the results: 24 results. No results when none.

ar.count: فلتر واحد مفعل، فلترين مفعلين، 3 فلاتر مفعلة، ثم النتائج: نتيجتين، 24 نتيجة، ما فيه نتائج

react.behavior: hand built on SearchField, Chip, DropdownMenu and Button

angular.behavior: div[dsFilterBar] host bindings; div[dsSearchField] for the search, a role group of pressable chips, the more menu on dsDropdownMenu with checkbox items, overflow read with a ResizeObserver and the scroll event
angular.note: value is a model ([(value)]), onClear the clear output; search takes the SearchField props in FilterBarSearch with the React names; end and a filter label take a string or a TemplateRef. The chips are a private stand in with the React Chip DOM until Chip has an Angular port. FilterBar.css is used as is.

styles.studio: One wrapping row: the search box takes the free room, the chip strip scrolls with soft edge fades, a muted count and a ghost clear button. The strip takes a line of its own below dialog.width.sm (a borrowed token until a filter-bar token exists).
styles.desk: The same layout, with the Desk pill chips and buttons
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: Chips that only change color when on
mistakes.right: Chips with aria-pressed and a check, which FilterBar uses

mistakes.wrong: Announcing the result count on every key press in the search box
mistakes.right: One polite announcement after the last change

mistakes.wrong: A filter row that makes the page scroll sideways on a phone
mistakes.right: The chip strip scrolls inside itself, with edge fades

mistakes.wrong: Twelve chips for filters people rarely use
mistakes.right: Three or four chips, and the rest under more
